headline: Heart sounds: the 5 spots to listen
stat_note: APE To Man, upper right to lower left
body:
Aortic: 2nd ICS, right sternal border
Pulmonic: 2nd ICS, left sternal border
Erb's point: 3rd ICS, left sternal border
Tricuspid: 4th ICS, left sternal border
Mitral: 5th ICS, left midclavicular line
source: Sources: Osmosis, APE To Man; Kenhub, Auscultation of the heart

headline: Your brain is small but very hungry
body: The brain makes up only about 2% of body weight, yet it uses nearly 20% of the oxygen you take in.
source: Source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center, The brain at rest

headline: You have about 5 million hair follicles
stat_note: hair follicles on the average body
body: More than 100,000 of those hairs are on your head. Scalp hair can grow for several years, so it can reach over 1 meter.
